name: Threat Hunting - Proofpoint clicked and then user had a login shortly after - Okta possible compromised account
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "click-permitted" and senderIP != null and recipient != null
| fields recipient, senderIP, url, GUID, _time as click_time
| join type = inner (
    dataset = okta_sso_raw
    | filter eventType = "user.session.start" or eventType = "user.authentication.sso"
    | alter outcome_result = arrayindex(regextract(outcome, "\"result\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
            ip = arrayindex(regextract(client, "\"ipAddress\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
            user_name = arrayindex(regextract(actor, "\"alternateId\"\s*:\s*\"([^\"]+)\""), 0)
    | filter outcome_result = "SUCCESS" and ip != null and user_name != null
    | filter not (user_name contains "svc-" or user_name contains "api-" or user_name contains "default.user")
    | fields user_name as loginUser, ip as loginIP, _time as login_time) as okta
  okta.loginIP = senderIP
| filter loginUser = recipient
     and login_time >= click_time
     and timestamp_diff(login_time, click_time, "MINUTE") <= 60
| comp count() as logins, min(login_time) as first_login
  by recipient, loginUser, senderIP, url, GUID, click_time
| fields recipient, loginUser, senderIP, url, GUID, click_time, first_login, logins
description: A user clicked a permitted Proofpoint URL and, within 60 minutes, their Okta account signed in from the IP that sent the phishing mail.
alert_name: Threat Hunting - Proofpoint clicked and then user had a login shortly after - possible compromised account
